body:
- **CSV-driven Stats (`<Stats src="./kpis.csv" />`).** Deferred. If a
  user has row data that's really a stat list, they can author the
  `<Stat>` elements directly — no real ergonomic win from CSV until
  there are many.
- **Inline sparkline / trendline in Stat.** Nice-to-have; sparkline
  already exists as a datagrid column type. Could pull in as an optional
  `trend-data=` attr later. Not MVP.
- **Icons in Stat.** Requires lucide (or similar) in `@filemark/mdx`,
  which isn't worth a new dep for one feature. Authors can embed an
  emoji in `title=`.
- **ADR index page / linked graph.** Each ADR is self-contained;
  cross-ADR navigation via conventional id references + markdown links.

---
